_method: Extracted from the source PDF's real vector geometry, same validated method as the main SHS register: grid lines detected programmatically, trade marks (X) detected via ink-pixel presence per cell, institution/location fields read via OCR. Cross-checked every institution's detected trade count against the register's own printed 'No. of Programmes' column. 233 institutions total. 42 rows (18%) show the mark-count differing from the printed count -- these were individually spot-checked: in every case examined, the physical marks were strong and unambiguous (ink-pixel counts 70+ vs. 0 for blanks, no borderline values), while the printed digit is a very small font in a narrow cell that OCR (and a human skimming a screenshot) can easily misread. The 'trades' list in each entry reflects the actual detected marks and should be treated as the more reliable field; the printed count is kept for reference and flagged where it disagrees.
